## What's coming in #115

SEER\*Stat doesn't query an external database directly — it imports its own
session and export formats. The likely path (an extract recipe that writes
a SEER\*Stat-compatible file for a chosen catchment or measure) is being
worked out in [cancer-on-ice#115](https://github.com/seandavi/cancer-on-ice/issues/115),
not invented here.

If you can reach a DuckDB CLI or Python environment in the meantime, the
[DuckDB CLI](duckdb-cli.qmd) page can write any query's result to a CSV
(`COPY (...) TO 'out.csv'`) as a starting point.
